I have implemented the `EventListener.BatchDurable` callback and the commit durability waiting and inspection APIs on a new branch (`batch-durable`), verified all unit tests, and committed the changes:

- **`EventListener.BatchDurable` & [`BatchDurableInfo`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f_9_h9e0/event.go#L761-L788)**:
  - Fires once per `Sync` commit after the WAL sync completes (including via [`Batch.SyncWait`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f_9_h9e0/batch.go#L1121-L1140) and on WAL sync failures), carrying `JobID`, `SeqNum`, `Err`, `ApplyDuration`, `SyncDuration`, `CorrelationID` (populated from [`WriteOptions.CommitCorrelationID`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f_9_h9e0/options.go#L48-L60)), `BatchSize`, and `KeyCount`.
  - Never triggers on non-sync commits or when `DisableWAL` is set.
  - Wired through [`TeeEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f_9_h9e0/event.go#L1200-L1205) and [`EventListener.EnsureDefaults`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f_9_h9e0/event.go#L947-L949).
- **Durability Tracking & Wait APIs ([durability.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f_9_h9e0/durability.go))**:
  - [`WaitForDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f_9_h9e0/durability.go#L455-L457) / [`WaitForDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f_9_h9e0/durability.go#L462-L464)
  - [`WaitForDurabilityBatch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f_9_h9e0/durability.go#L468-L470) / [`WaitForDurabilityBatchContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f_9_h9e0/durability.go#L476-L499)
  - [`WaitForJobDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f_9_h9e0/durability.go#L503-L505) / [`WaitForJobDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f_9_h9e0/durability.go#L510-L512) with bounded job history retention (`"expired"` vs `"unknown"` errors)
  - [`DurableState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f_9_h9e0/durability.go#L516-L518), [`DurabilityNotify`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f_9_h9e0/durability.go#L523-L525) (with bounded active subscriptions), and [`DurabilityStats`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f_9_h9e0/durability.go#L529-L531)
- **Metrics ([metrics.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f_9_h9e0/metrics.go#L261-L267), [db.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-f_9_h9e0/db.go#L2289-L2293))**:
  - Added `Metrics.DurableCommitCount` and `Metrics.DurableCommitDuration`, accumulated only when `EventListener.BatchDurable` is configured.
